node.title: E22 tail-removed factor-manifest soundness
node.statement: If a manifest supplies one common tail B, dyadic local moduli M_i>t, verifies |B|<min_i M_i, and proves that each non-tail locator L_{T_i\B} equals a product of distinct quotient-fiber factors X^{M_i}-z, then e22_common_tail_invariance_payload holds.
node.attack_surface: formal conversion from explicit quotient-factor manifest to full-fiber and kernel-invariant non-tail sets
node.falsifier: a verified tail-removed quotient-factor manifest whose non-tail set is not kernel-invariant or whose tail/modulus data do not satisfy the common-tail payload
